description: Upload a local photo or video file (up to 10 GB) into the library, optionally into an album. Sent in resumable chunks, so a dropped connection resumes instead of restarting. Returns the new item. Uploading a file that is already in the library returns the existing item.

album_key.description: Optional album to add the upload to.

file_name.description: Optional name to store it under (default: the file's own name).

file_path.description: Absolute path of a local image or video file.

google_account_email.description: The signed-in Google account email whose Google Photos library to use (e.g. the one at /u/1/). Call list_accounts first and confirm with the user; do not guess.

notification_message.description: Short user-facing sentence for this action if the follow-up reply fails. Plain text only; do not mention template syntax or variable names.

name: upload_media
